team: Ask to be matched with Engineering Productivity Research (EPR) / Developer Infrastructure
summary: A 12–14 week paid research internship for PhD students. The posting is general, and you are matched to a team, so say clearly in your application that you want developer productivity research.
whyFit: Google's developer productivity researchers publish empirical and human-factors SE work at ICSE, FSE, and CHI.
requirements: Enrolled in a PhD in CS or a related field
notes: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so apply early.

team: Project matching (aim for developer tools / productivity teams)
summary: An engineering internship (not research) for PhD students. You are matched to a project and can ask for developer-tools teams.
whyFit: A backup route into Google's internal developer-tools organization.
notes: The posting says it may close earlier once projects are full.

team: Software engineering & developer experience groups; EPIC (HCI); Inclusive Futures
summary: Each team posts its own internship, and new postings appear through the fall. Many MSR internships also start with a direct email to a potential mentor.
whyFit: MSR's SE and HCI researchers are core members of the ICSE, FSE, CHI, and CSCW communities.
requirements: 1+ year of original research (papers or preprints)
notes: No SE-specific Summer 2027 posting found yet.

role: Research Scientist Intern (PhD) / UX Researcher Intern
summary: Meta posted its first Summer 2027 intern roles in late September 2026, and more are expected through the fall. Internships run 12–24 weeks.
whyFit: Meta's developer infrastructure organization publishes developer productivity studies at ICSE and FSE.

summary: Project-based internships about how developers work with AI in IDEs. One recent project built an eye-tracking VR prototype for coding tasks.
whyFit: Directly about developer experience. The team does both HCI and SE research.
requirements: Varies by project; check each project page
notes: The team also runs AI4SE internships.

team: GitHub Next; CoreAI (VS Code, GitHub, Azure dev tools)
summary: GitHub research internships are rare. Microsoft's CoreAI organization has Summer 2027 SWE internships on AI developer tools (VS Code, GitHub).
whyFit: These teams build the tools that developer experience research studies.

summary: Summer research internship with a mentor, ideally continuing into your thesis. The 2026 cycle was hybrid and co-located with mentors.
whyFit: A strong CHI/UIST lab with end-user programming and creative-tools work.
requirements: Enrolled in a PhD or Master's program

summary: Research internships in human-centered AI, including how developers use AI coding tools.
whyFit: The Human-Centered AI group publishes at CHI and IUI, and its work overlaps with developer tooling.

team: AWS AI for code / developer tools
summary: Applied science internships. Some teams work on AI coding assistants and developer tools.
whyFit: Some AWS developer-tools teams publish at ICSE, FSE, and ASE. This one is more ML-heavy than the others.

summary: HCI research internships focused on tools for designers and makers.
whyFit: A strong CHI/UIST lab. A good fit if your work leans toward end-user programming.
